Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D single-item candidate modelling turnaround. Production ID item.design.base.small-axe, native inventory cursor ICURS112.
Input image 1 is the original licensed inventory sprite, PRIMARY silhouette/proportion/palette reference only. Input image 2 is an already generated Claymore board, LAYOUT and neutral material presentation reference only, never include its sword.
Reconstruct ONE Small Axe exactly as recognizable in image 1, even where it differs from a conventional small axe: an upright short slender axe with a tall dark iron blade to the LEFT of its shaft, a bright silver sharpened outer left edge, a tall near-rectangular blade body tapering downward into a pointed beard, restrained dark interlaced geometric engraving on the blade face. At the top of the central haft is a small silver spear-shaped cap; on the RIGHT behind the head is a small triangular iron poll/spike with a visibly recessed dark triangular center. Preserve the distinctive asymmetric outline. Red leather wrapping covers most of the straight narrow handle below the head; small aged brass collar above the silver rounded faceted bottom pommel. A RED leather wrist lanyard is tied below the pommel and hangs leftward in a loose oval loop, matching the visible red shape in the sprite. Keep that loop in every view; no wooden brown handle substitute.
Create one clean high-definition concept sheet showing the exact SAME object in FRONT, SIDE edge-on thickness, BACK, and 3-4 perspective views plus one small ICON inset that is a NEW HD rendered view of the same axe. Entire objects including red lanyard visible, four major views have the same length/proportions/materials. Reverse view should correctly reverse the asymmetric head, not create a second cutting blade. Dark neutral charcoal background, neutral soft white studio illumination with no warm color cast, no scenery, no dramatic cast shadow. Realistic restrained worn steel/iron, red leather, aged brass, crisp readable surface details. Infer hidden reverse surfaces and thickness conservatively from the sprite; no invented heraldic symbols. Small title exactly 'SMALL AXE'; small labels exactly 'FRONT', 'SIDE', 'BACK', '3-4', 'ICON'. Add small footer 'CANDIDATE - REVERSE AND THICKNESS INFERRED'.
Do not paste, trace, or reproduce the pixel sprite, its black image rectangle, or the reference board into this sheet. The ICON inset must be newly rendered HD, never pixel art. No hands, people, extra items, added skulls, gems, glow, runes, oversized spikes, or watermark. This is concept only, not a finished runtime icon.
